conf.description: cisco-asa vpn-aaa dataset, snmp-trap format (CISCO-SYSLOG-MIB clogMessageGenerated trap): no stock Elastic integration or Cribl pack ingests SNMP traps, so this is a genuine Cribl-side parsing pipeline (mechanism: cribl-pipeline) rather than a thin passthrough. An upstream SNMP trap receiver terminates the PDU and forwards the decoded varbinds as JSON; this pipeline extracts them, maps the MIB fields to ECS, and re-derives log.syslog.severity.code from the MIB's 1-8 enum.

conf.comment: cisco-asa / vpn-aaa / snmp-trap: CISCO-SYSLOG-MIB clogHistTable varbinds for the 113xxx/722xxx family, forwarded as JSON by an upstream SNMP trap receiver (snmptrapd or equivalent) since neither Cribl nor the Elastic integration decodes SNMP PDUs. clogHistMsgText carries the full 254-byte-truncated ASA sentence, still keyed by the same per-message-ID grammar as the syslog-raw feed -- this pipeline does not re-run that body grok (out of scope / duplicative with the syslog-raw pipeline's deferred Elastic parsing) and only maps the MIB-level fields.

functions.description: document the varbind source and scope of this pipeline
extract the JSON-encoded varbind object the upstream SNMP trap receiver forwards
map the mapped/near-1:1 CISCO-SYSLOG-MIB fields onto their ECS targets per the field table
apply the field table's explicit severity-offset transform and route the two unmapped varbinds to their custom cisco.asa.snmp.* targets
tag the event with its dataset
